title: U.S.–China People-to-People Relationship Infrastructure — 2026
adds: Open, large and highly asymmetric, not one exchange system: 265,919 Chinese students in U.S. institutions (2024/25) vs 1,749 U.S. credit-bearing students in China (2023/24); Xi's youth invitation was 50,000 over five years, not 100,000, and China reports more than 50,000 visits by May 2026 without a participant-level ledger; air rights (50 weekly roundtrips per side) exceed operated service; U.S. nationals generally still need a Chinese visa; the 2024 STA protocol keeps basic-research cooperation alive through 2029; journalism is the most visibly constrained lane; subnational MOUs are real but nonbinding and unfunded. The relationship can become socially busy yet epistemically thinner.
contribution_scope: Reviewed navigation description; read each source for its own claim and clock.
navigation_contribution: Separate travel, aviation, education, research, journalism, youth visits and local-government exchanges by their promises, permissions and operating evidence.
summary_role: Exact saved study bottom line; object-local evidence date retained.
